body_content:
FAO Sesame Access Systems Ltd

Please find your igus® invoice 0466716 for your order 21617-1597 attached

Please disregard this email if you paid for the goods in advance, this is just for your
records  

 

If the order has not been paid, please could you pay each invoice separately quoting
the invoice number and your company name?  This really helps us to process your
payment fast.   

 

Please don’t quote your account number, the sales order number or anything else,
as this tends to slow us down. 

 

It would be helpful if this referencing was adopted for all future payments. Of course,
disregard this for bulk payments 

 

If you have any queries regarding your statement or anything else, then please
contact us by return e-mail or by calling 01604 677240. If you like, you can try our
online chat, we think it’s pretty cool. 

 

Best regards 

igus® Accounts Receivables Team 

https://www.igus.co.uk

01604 677240 

igus® UK, Caswell Road, Northampton, NN4 7PW 

 

Remember; you can order all igus® catalogue parts online at https://www.igus.co.uk, pay with credit card, paypal, or on
account (subject to credit checks) For Irish customers you can order at https://www.igus.ie with credit card.

Please observe the provisions of Article 12g EU Regulation 833/2014 and all other associated Russia sanctions applicable in the UK,
the EU and internationally, when purchasing or reselling any igus products.

REACH Customer Information (Regulation (EC) No. 1907/2006 - Article 33)
TPE Flame Retardant chainflex® products contain more than 0.1% (w/w) of decabromodiphenylethane
(CAS No. 84852-53-9), a substance identified as an SVHC and listed on the REACH Candidate List.

Note: The use of these products remains fully permitted. Inclusion of the substance on the Candidate List
does not constitute a ban, but it does require that this information be communicated to customers
